_readme: Single source of truth for prices. The server reads this file to compute every charge, so the browser can never set a price. 'from' is the starting price for custom work; the deposit is depositRate x from. Premade items are charged their full price. To sell a ready-made item, add it to 'premade' (image goes in /img/shop/). Set 'visible' to false to hide one. Buy Now ('premade') items with madeToOrder:true have no stock limit. 'personalize' fields (max 3) are asked on Stripe's checkout page. 'shopOpen' false hides Buy Now on siecraft.com (preview links still show it for testing).
